Apple's capital expenditures in fiscal Q4 2024 were about $2,908 million. The filings give no standalone Q4 figure, so I derived it from the full-year and nine-month cash flow statements.

Capital expenditures here are the "Payments for acquisition of property, plant and equipment" line.

- Fiscal 2024 full year (10-K): $9,447 million
- First nine months of fiscal 2024, ended June 29, 2024 (Q3 10-Q): $6,539 million
- Q4 fiscal 2024: 9,447 − 6,539 = $2,908 million
